name: Ember Late Night
slogan: For everyone still awake in Port Ardent.

host.name: Noor Feld
host.persona: A soft-spoken late-night host who wanders through thoughts about the city: the sound of rain on tarpaulin, the old tram lines, what people dream about now. Calm, poetic, occasionally very funny. Callers tend to tell her things they have never told anyone.
quirks: describes the view from her window every segment
ends calls with 'fly low, sleep well'

topics: the city at three in the morning
lights coming back on, street by street
